summary: Backend-only regression. Verified deployment health-probe fix and dashboard optimization. All 9 tests passed: /health (root, no /api prefix) returns 200 {'status':'ok'} on backend container (localhost:8001); /api/health returns 200; /api/dashboard for demo distributor returns stats.total_orders (int), <=5 recent_orders, wallet 500/500/1000, income_series and today_income present; core flows regression intact — admin /api/admin/dashboard, /api/wallet (500/500/1000/500 wd), /api/team (root + members with photos + downline_count), /api/referral, /api/products, /api/auth/send-otp all 200.

minor.issue: Public ingress does NOT route /health to backend (only /api/* is routed to backend; /health hits frontend and returns index.html). This is fine for K8s deployment because the container health probe is executed inside the pod against the backend port (localhost:8001), where /health now correctly returns 200. Not a bug — just noting the ingress behavior for future context.

critical_code_review_comments: Health route implementation is correct: both @app.get('/health') and @app.get('/api/health') are registered on the FastAPI app, satisfying K8s liveness/readiness probes that call the non-prefixed path directly against the container.
Dashboard optimization (count_documents + limit(5) + commissions projection) working correctly — response shape unchanged, recent_orders capped at 5, wallet snapshot preserved.
